instruction: A candid documentary full shot of an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands upright, looking directly towards the right. On the right, the man in the black shirt and blue shorts (R1) balances on his left leg while executing a high side kick towards the woman's midsection, leaning his upper body back for balance. Bright overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the entire scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
